title: Images Tutorial
supports: Informative, decorative, and functional alternative text
explanation: Explains how to choose alternative text according to an image’s purpose. Informative images need a useful text alternative, decorative images should not add noise to assistive technology, and functional images need their action or destination explained.
example: For a meaningful chart, describe the information conveyed; for a decorative flourish, use an empty alt attribute (alt="") so screen readers can skip it.
